verdict.rationale: Codegen agents present a structured plan of implementation steps before executing (codegen-docs-22), and agent runs can be paused/resumed (codegen-docs-35), suggesting some checkpointing exists, but there is no documented workflow requiring an engineering-lead's explicit approval of scope/contract as a gate before the agent is allowed to touch the repo. Missing for 10: an explicit approval/sign-off step tied to plan review, evidence that repo modification is blocked until a lead approves, and any UI/CLI flow for accepting or rejecting the proposed scope.
